mcqs.q: How was the US civil rights movement achieved?
options: Japan attacked to support Germany's invasion of the USSR.
Through decades of mass organising — NAACP legal work, grassroots campaigns, sit-ins, freedom rides — alongside leaders like King and Malcolm X.
Lincoln ended segregation by signing the 14th Amendment.
Martin Luther King's 'I Have a Dream' speech ended segregation.

mcqs.q: Why did Japan attack Pearl Harbor?
options: To cripple the US Pacific Fleet and buy time to secure resource-rich Southeast Asia after the US oil embargo threatened Japanese expansion.
Japan attacked to support Germany's invasion of the USSR.
Japan attacked because it wanted to conquer America.
It began when the USSR shot down a US spy plane.
